name: CMNS
full_name: Multi-section magnetic soft robot with collaborative multirobot navigation system (CMNS)
devices_driven: own telescoping two-tube soft robot: Tube-I OD 1.8 / ID 1.2 mm, Tube-II OD 3.5 / ID 2.5 mm
n_dof_detail: UR3e carries a 30 mm NdFeB N42 permanent magnet; second manipulator carries ultrasound probe; seven-joint redundancy handled by QP controller
imaging_compat: ultrasound tracking of the tip, closed loop
validation_detail: multi-bifurcation intravascular phantom navigation; counts N.R.
key_numbers: shape error 3.1-3.9 deg, tip error about 1.0-1.4 mm (Table 2); bending range -125 to 125 deg tested
sim_model: optimised Cosserat rod model with external heterogeneous field (full)
sim2real_detail: model-based control using the Cosserat model on the hardware; no learned policy
